facts.fact: The Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation's written reply says InkubaLM, a South African-developed large language model for low-resource African languages created by Lelapa AI, has emerged from privately or donor-funded work, while no government-backed home-grown LLM is being developed.

ZAF.note: SADiLaR resources are language resources for research, not stated as AI datasets.
Sovereignty appears only as a description of InkubaLM and Masakhane; nothing on state data or systems.
